name: University of Freiburg
header:
University of Freiburg
Germany · MSc Mathematics; doctorate by supervisor agreement, including an exceptional bachelor route
European research-fit addition; not a US ranking entry.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc now requires English B2, not German.
• The bachelor-to-doctorate exception requires top5% evidence and a formal aptitude procedure.
• An incoming winter student cannot assume the March Deutschlandstipendium competition will fund the first
semester.
• No guaranteed MSc stipend; budget international tuition separately.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: recognized mathematics/equivalent bachelor of at least three years;103 ECTS of mathematics
including16 each in analysis, linear algebra, advanced pure mathematics and advanced applied mathematics.
Committee exceptions are possible. Pending degree accepted with thesis-status or expected-completion
evidence. Doctorate normally requires an above-average master/equivalent, but §5(3) permits exceptional
bachelor graduates in the top5% of their programme over the preceding six semesters, with faculty
sponsorship, assigned master modules and an oral aptitude examination within about two semesters.
UChicago credit, rank and degree equivalence require individual confirmation. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: map UChicago courses to the four subject-credit requirements, obtain English-medium-degree evidence,
register in HISinOne and submit uploaded records. Clarify whether APS wording for applicants from
China/India/Vietnam applies to a US-earned degree. Doctorate: obtain an eligible supervisor’s agreement first,
clarify the bachelor exception, sign the doctoral agreement, then submit faculty acceptance materials. [s1] [s3]
[s5] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc does not require prior supervisor acceptance. A doctorate does: contact an eligible professor with a
precise research fit and ask about qualification equivalence and a funded opening. Faculty evidence below
establishes research relevance, not willingness to admit a new student. [s5] [s13]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
HISinOne registration, academic uploads and final submission are required; uploads alone do not apply.
Department suggests surname/document-type filenames, PDF/JPG and5MB per file. Doctoral acceptance
begins in HISinOne but also requires the generated signed paper application and complete supporting
documents at the dean’s office. [s1] [s5]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
The switch to English and current admission regulations are confirmed for 2026 onward. MSc deadlines are
standing annual rules, not a separately announced 2027 timetable. The 2027-28 scholarship notice contains an
inconsistent closing year, and its FAQ still includes 2026 examples. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s10]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Conflict]
MSc non-EU applicant: July 15 for winter and January 15 for summer, standing annual dates; no 2027 cutoff
clock is published. Central winter window opens April 15, while the departmental banner says May 15. Doctoral
faculty acceptance is individual, with no annual admissions deadline stated; project-job deadlines are separate.
[s1] [s2] [s5]
Funding consideration [Conflict]
No automatic funded MSc competition. Deutschlandstipendium is available before entry only for summer
entrants; a winter 2027 entrant normally first applies after enrollment, in March 2028. Its new notice gives
March 1, 2027-March 31, 2028 for the 2027-28 round, an apparent year inconsistency requiring confirmation.
Doctoral employment/fellowship deadlines depend on the specific open position. [s10] [s11]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc admission does not request recommendations. Deutschlandstipendium excludes
recommendation letters. Individual doctoral job calls may require them; there is no universal referee deadline
in the faculty acceptance procedure. [s3] [s5] [s10]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
MSc English evidence is a required application document; submit with the application by July 15/January 15. A
completed English-language US degree is an accepted B2 route. No GRE submission deadline is specified. [s1]
[s3] [s4]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
MSc application must be submitted, not merely saved, with required academic/language evidence by the
applicable deadline. Final certified degree is needed for enrollment. Doctoral acceptance requires the complete
signed application and supporting documents; the faculty normally decides within three months under its
regulations. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s7]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal offer-acceptance date is published for these routes. Follow the individual admission/enrollment
notice and any employment or scholarship offer; April 15 is not established as a protection here. [s1] [s5]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc is taught in English from winter 2026-27 and requires B2 English, with no German requirement. Accepted
examples include an English-medium undergraduate degree in the United States, TOEFL iBT72 on the older
scale or4 on the new scale, and IELTS5.5; test evidence normally must be within two years. Doctoral rules allow
adequate German or English evidence as applicable. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed English-medium UChicago undergraduate degree fits the central US-degree evidence route. The
exact substitute accepted while the degree is still pending is not explicit; obtain a university
instruction-language/completion letter and confirm with admissions. This is an evidence route, not a citizenship
exemption. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not listed in the binding MSc admission checklist or ordinary faculty doctoral-acceptance requirements. The
public pages do not say whether unsolicited scores would be considered. [s3] [s6]

MSc: degree certificate or pending-completion evidence, transcript/records demonstrating content and grades

sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
MSc: not requested in the statutory application checklist. Doctoral acceptance: current CV including
educational/professional development; no public length or typography rule. A particular job may impose
additional requirements. [s3] [s7]
Statement of purpose; Personal / background statement; Research-interest statement; Writing
sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate document in this category is required by the MSc checklist. No universal version or length limit is
specified for individual doctoral job applications; obtain the supervisor/job-specific instructions. The doctoral
thesis/publications forms for degree completion are not entrance-application requirements. [s3] [s5]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
MSc: no proposal requested. Doctoral acceptance identifies the intended thesis topic in the application and
supervision agreement; a stand-alone proposal length/format is not specified in the faculty rules. Supervisor or
funding-call expectations must be obtained separately. [s3] [s6] [s7]

Course-list document [Standing rule]

identified. See the credit-equivalence requirements above. [s1] [s3]

Deutschlandstipendium: no motivation or recommendation letters are considered. Upload degree certificate,
current transcript if enrolled, and applicable evidence of achievement, engagement or personal circumstances
as PDFs; supporting documents may be German, English or French, otherwise certified translations are
required. No general scholarship essay prompt applies. [s10]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No guaranteed annual MSc stipend; the university states it does not offer fully funded scholarships.
Deutschlandstipendium is EUR300/month for 12 months, EUR3600 total by arithmetic, for eligible selected
students. Doctoral salary/stipend amount depends on a separate employment or fellowship offer; no universal
2027 mathematics amount verified. [s10] [s11] [s12]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium lasts one year, renewable through a fresh full application up to the standard study
duration. Doctoral funding duration is contract-specific and is not implied by academic acceptance; the
doctoral regulations’ five-year study period is not a five-year funding promise. [s6] [s10]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium accepts all nationalities, but winter entrants cannot use the pre-entry
summer-applicant route and doctoral students are excluded. Foreign students may search DAAD and other
funders; eligibility is award-specific. US F-1 status does not itself establish German funding eligibility. [s10] [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
For mathematics, the current Deutschlandstipendium table places the faculty in the German1.3-or-better
category; selection also considers engagement and personal circumstances. Concurrent merit funding of at
least EUR30/month on average is generally incompatible unless sponsors approve. These standing rules need
reconfirmation for the first eligible round. [s10]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium requires a separate online scholarship application and supporting evidence; ordinary
MSc admission does not enter it automatically. Doctoral employment/fellowship is a separate arrangement
from faculty academic acceptance. [s5] [s10]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
International Office emergency/completion aid is for enrolled students facing unforeseen hardship or near
degree completion, not a full incoming funding package; consultation is required and applications are rolling.
The university points to DAAD and foundation databases. No guaranteed amount or universal deadline for
those external routes is established. [s11] [s12]
Application fee [Unresolved]
No explicit mathematics application-fee amount was established. Current non-EU consecutive MSc tuition is
EUR1500/semester plus EUR190 semester contribution; these are study/enrollment charges, not application
fees, and 2027 changes remain possible. Doctoral tuition treatment must be checked separately from MSc
charges. [s8] [s9]

Fee waiver [Unresolved]
International-tuition exceptions depend on legal/residency/educational circumstances; UChicago study or US
F-1 status alone does not establish one. After admission, the fee notice/portal provides the relevant exemption
process. An application-fee waiver process was not verified. [s9]

Pay attention to
• MSc now requires English B2, not German.
• The bachelor-to-doctorate exception requires top5% evidence and a formal aptitude procedure.
• An incoming winter student cannot assume the March Deutschlandstipendium competition will fund the first
semester.
• No guaranteed MSc stipend; budget international tuition separately.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: recognized mathematics/equivalent bachelor of at least three years;103 ECTS of mathematics
including16 each in analysis, linear algebra, advanced pure mathematics and advanced applied mathematics.
Committee exceptions are possible. Pending degree accepted with thesis-status or expected-completion
evidence. Doctorate normally requires an above-average master/equivalent, but §5(3) permits exceptional
bachelor graduates in the top5% of their programme over the preceding six semesters, with faculty
sponsorship, assigned master modules and an oral aptitude examination within about two semesters.
UChicago credit, rank and degree equivalence require individual confirmation. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
MSc: map UChicago courses to the four subject-credit requirements, obtain English-medium-degree evidence,
register in HISinOne and submit uploaded records. Clarify whether APS wording for applicants from
China/India/Vietnam applies to a US-earned degree. Doctorate: obtain an eligible supervisor’s agreement first,
clarify the bachelor exception, sign the doctoral agreement, then submit faculty acceptance materials. [s1] [s3]
[s5] [s6]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc does not require prior supervisor acceptance. A doctorate does: contact an eligible professor with a
precise research fit and ask about qualification equivalence and a funded opening. Faculty evidence below
establishes research relevance, not willingness to admit a new student. [s5] [s13]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
HISinOne registration, academic uploads and final submission are required; uploads alone do not apply.
Department suggests surname/document-type filenames, PDF/JPG and5MB per file. Doctoral acceptance
begins in HISinOne but also requires the generated signed paper application and complete supporting
documents at the dean’s office. [s1] [s5]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
The switch to English and current admission regulations are confirmed for 2026 onward. MSc deadlines are
standing annual rules, not a separately announced 2027 timetable. The 2027-28 scholarship notice contains an
inconsistent closing year, and its FAQ still includes 2026 examples. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s10]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Conflict]
MSc non-EU applicant: July 15 for winter and January 15 for summer, standing annual dates; no 2027 cutoff
clock is published. Central winter window opens April 15, while the departmental banner says May 15. Doctoral
faculty acceptance is individual, with no annual admissions deadline stated; project-job deadlines are separate.
[s1] [s2] [s5]
Funding consideration [Conflict]
No automatic funded MSc competition. Deutschlandstipendium is available before entry only for summer
entrants; a winter 2027 entrant normally first applies after enrollment, in March 2028. Its new notice gives
March 1, 2027-March 31, 2028 for the 2027-28 round, an apparent year inconsistency requiring confirmation.
Doctoral employment/fellowship deadlines depend on the specific open position. [s10] [s11]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc admission does not request recommendations. Deutschlandstipendium excludes
recommendation letters. Individual doctoral job calls may require them; there is no universal referee deadline
in the faculty acceptance procedure. [s3] [s5] [s10]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
MSc English evidence is a required application document; submit with the application by July 15/January 15. A
completed English-language US degree is an accepted B2 route. No GRE submission deadline is specified. [s1]
[s3] [s4]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
MSc application must be submitted, not merely saved, with required academic/language evidence by the
applicable deadline. Final certified degree is needed for enrollment. Doctoral acceptance requires the complete
signed application and supporting documents; the faculty normally decides within three months under its
regulations. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s7]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
No universal offer-acceptance date is published for these routes. Follow the individual admission/enrollment
notice and any employment or scholarship offer; April 15 is not established as a protection here. [s1] [s5]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc is taught in English from winter 2026-27 and requires B2 English, with no German requirement. Accepted
examples include an English-medium undergraduate degree in the United States, TOEFL iBT72 on the older
scale or4 on the new scale, and IELTS5.5; test evidence normally must be within two years. Doctoral rules allow
adequate German or English evidence as applicable. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s7]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed English-medium UChicago undergraduate degree fits the central US-degree evidence route. The
exact substitute accepted while the degree is still pending is not explicit; obtain a university
instruction-language/completion letter and confirm with admissions. This is an evidence route, not a citizenship
exemption. [s4]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not listed in the binding MSc admission checklist or ordinary faculty doctoral-acceptance requirements. The
public pages do not say whether unsolicited scores would be considered. [s3] [s6]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
MSc: degree certificate or pending-completion evidence, transcript/records demonstrating content and grades
of prior study, and language proof. Documents not in German, English or French need certified German/English
translations. Doctoral acceptance requires qualification evidence, supervision agreement, CV and declarations
concerning prior/current doctoral applications and eligibility. [s1] [s3] [s6] [s7]

No separate prescribed mathematics-course spreadsheet is listed. The transcript or accompanying
study-content record must establish the103-ECTS requirement and its four16-ECTS components; do not
assume course titles alone will establish equivalence. [s1] [s3]
Course descriptions [Standing rule]
Study-content evidence is required; syllabus/module descriptions can document equivalence where the
transcript does not. No separate length limit is public. HISinOne accepts PDF/JPG uploads up to5MB per file
under the departmental instructions. [s1] [s3]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Ordinary MSc: zero letters in the complete statutory checklist. Faculty doctoral acceptance: supervisor
agreement rather than a specified number of external references. Any funded job may add its own letter
requirements. [s3] [s5] [s6]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium does not consider recommendation letters or motivation letters. No additional
scholarship-referee questionnaire applies to that scheme. Other external awards or doctoral jobs have
independent rules. [s10]
What sends the invitation; Before versus after submission; Receipt confirmation; Updating and
reusing letters [Standing rule]
Not applicable to ordinary MSc admission or Deutschlandstipendium, which do not request recommendation
letters. No general automated reference process is established for individual doctoral opportunities; check the
actual job or fellowship call. [s3] [s5] [s10]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
MSc: not requested in the statutory application checklist. Doctoral acceptance: current CV including
educational/professional development; no public length or typography rule. A particular job may impose
additional requirements. [s3] [s7]
Statement of purpose; Personal / background statement; Research-interest statement; Writing
sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list [Standing rule]
No separate document in this category is required by the MSc checklist. No universal version or length limit is
specified for individual doctoral job applications; obtain the supervisor/job-specific instructions. The doctoral
thesis/publications forms for degree completion are not entrance-application requirements. [s3] [s5]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
MSc: no proposal requested. Doctoral acceptance identifies the intended thesis topic in the application and
supervision agreement; a stand-alone proposal length/format is not specified in the faculty rules. Supervisor or
funding-call expectations must be obtained separately. [s3] [s6] [s7]

Deutschlandstipendium: no motivation or recommendation letters are considered. Upload degree certificate,

MSc has no additional essay in the statutory checklist. Doctoral acceptance requires the signed official form

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No guaranteed annual MSc stipend; the university states it does not offer fully funded scholarships.
Deutschlandstipendium is EUR300/month for 12 months, EUR3600 total by arithmetic, for eligible selected
students. Doctoral salary/stipend amount depends on a separate employment or fellowship offer; no universal
2027 mathematics amount verified. [s10] [s11] [s12]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium lasts one year, renewable through a fresh full application up to the standard study
duration. Doctoral funding duration is contract-specific and is not implied by academic acceptance; the
doctoral regulations’ five-year study period is not a five-year funding promise. [s6] [s10]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium accepts all nationalities, but winter entrants cannot use the pre-entry
summer-applicant route and doctoral students are excluded. Foreign students may search DAAD and other
funders; eligibility is award-specific. US F-1 status does not itself establish German funding eligibility. [s10] [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
For mathematics, the current Deutschlandstipendium table places the faculty in the German1.3-or-better
category; selection also considers engagement and personal circumstances. Concurrent merit funding of at
least EUR30/month on average is generally incompatible unless sponsors approve. These standing rules need
reconfirmation for the first eligible round. [s10]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium requires a separate online scholarship application and supporting evidence; ordinary
MSc admission does not enter it automatically. Doctoral employment/fellowship is a separate arrangement
from faculty academic acceptance. [s5] [s10]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
International Office emergency/completion aid is for enrolled students facing unforeseen hardship or near
degree completion, not a full incoming funding package; consultation is required and applications are rolling.
The university points to DAAD and foundation databases. No guaranteed amount or universal deadline for
those external routes is established. [s11] [s12]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: recognized mathematics/equivalent bachelor of at least three years;103 ECTS of mathematics
including16 each in analysis, linear algebra, advanced pure mathematics and advanced applied mathematics.
Committee exceptions are possible. Pending degree accepted with thesis-status or expected-completion
evidence. Doctorate normally requires an above-average master/equivalent, but §5(3) permits exceptional
bachelor graduates in the top5% of their programme over the preceding six semesters, with faculty
sponsorship, assigned master modules and an oral aptitude examination within about two semesters.
UChicago credit, rank and degree equivalence require individual confirmation. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s6]

examples include an English-medium undergraduate degree in the United States, TOEFL iBT72 on the older

exemption. [s4]

MSc: degree certificate or pending-completion evidence, transcript/records demonstrating content and grades
of prior study, and language proof. Documents not in German, English or French need certified German/English
translations. Doctoral acceptance requires qualification evidence, supervision agreement, CV and declarations
concerning prior/current doctoral applications and eligibility. [s1] [s3] [s6] [s7]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
No separate prescribed mathematics-course spreadsheet is listed. The transcript or accompanying

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
No guaranteed annual MSc stipend; the university states it does not offer fully funded scholarships.
Deutschlandstipendium is EUR300/month for 12 months, EUR3600 total by arithmetic, for eligible selected
students. Doctoral salary/stipend amount depends on a separate employment or fellowship offer; no universal
2027 mathematics amount verified. [s10] [s11] [s12]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium lasts one year, renewable through a fresh full application up to the standard study
duration. Doctoral funding duration is contract-specific and is not implied by academic acceptance; the
doctoral regulations’ five-year study period is not a five-year funding promise. [s6] [s10]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium accepts all nationalities, but winter entrants cannot use the pre-entry
summer-applicant route and doctoral students are excluded. Foreign students may search DAAD and other
funders; eligibility is award-specific. US F-1 status does not itself establish German funding eligibility. [s10] [s11]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
For mathematics, the current Deutschlandstipendium table places the faculty in the German1.3-or-better
category; selection also considers engagement and personal circumstances. Concurrent merit funding of at
least EUR30/month on average is generally incompatible unless sponsors approve. These standing rules need
reconfirmation for the first eligible round. [s10]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Deutschlandstipendium requires a separate online scholarship application and supporting evidence; ordinary
MSc admission does not enter it automatically. Doctoral employment/fellowship is a separate arrangement
from faculty academic acceptance. [s5] [s10]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
International Office emergency/completion aid is for enrolled students facing unforeseen hardship or near
degree completion, not a full incoming funding package; consultation is required and applications are rolling.
The university points to DAAD and foundation databases. No guaranteed amount or universal deadline for
those external routes is established. [s11] [s12]
